thread:
Maya Patel: quick sync — notebook-demo e2e is failing on CI after sdk-python 1.4.0 serializer change. error shows: 
```
  TypeError: cannot serialize <KVCache> for request body
```
I'm worried this will block the changelog cutoff tomorrow 11:59p PT. who can triage? :eyes:

Samir Gupta: ugh, saw that in my inbox. looks like the sample app uses internal serializer path that changed shape. failing job is `pkg-ci/ci-e2e-notebook-demo` (job #482). link: https://ci.internal/redwood/482 :(

Leo Chen: assigning to me to start repro locally. Maya — can you paste the exact failing command from CI?

Maya Patel: sure — from job log: `pytest tests/e2e/test_notebook_demo.py::test_run_notebook -q`

pkg-ci: CI job pkg-ci/ci-e2e-notebook-demo #482 failed (exit code 1). Full log: https://ci.internal/logs/482 

Ana Rodriguez: quick thought — the new SDK switched from bytes -> memoryview for kv cache blobs, sampleapp's upload step does `json.dumps(obj)` which breaks. we should either update sampleapp to call `.tolist()` or add a compatibility shim in the SDK.

Samir Gupta: shim in SDK might be safer for patch release. minimal fix: in serializer `if hasattr(obj, 'tobytes') or isinstance(obj, memoryview): return obj.tobytes()` — tempted to open a 1-line PR to revert behavior but prefer compatibility.

Maya Patel: can we get a green canary before cutoff? Docs team also blocked because the quickstart snippet references notebook-demo output.

Leo Chen: i'm starting a branch now. local repro fails with same traceback. will open PR `redwood/sdk-python#3712` with the shim and add a unit test. ETA ~2h.

Ana Rodriguez: if Leo can PR, i can update the sampleapp quickstart in docs to use `bytes(...)` defensively. that should buy us time for a proper SDK cleanup in next minor.

devex-bot: @Maya Patel requested a challog cutoff reminder. Changelog cutoff ETA: 2026-03-18 06:59:00 UTC (tomorrow 11:59p PT). :alarm_clock:

Samir Gupta: tagging @devex-leads: do we allow a 1.4.1 compatibility patch after cutoff if it only affects CI/sampleapps?

Maya Patel: we prefer to land it before cutoff if possible — reduces downstream churn for customers trying quickstarts.

Leo Chen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-python/pull/3712 — includes shim + unit test. CI triggered (pkg-ci/ci-unit-sdk-python). i'll re-run e2e once unit CI is green.

pkg-ci: CI job pkg-ci/ci-unit-sdk-python #193 triggered.

Samir Gupta: quick review incoming. if unit CI passes i can approve and we can cut a patch release (1.4.1) and roll canary to hosted for sampleapp smoke. i'll stand by to cut the release.

Ana Rodriguez: docs change PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/882 — small defensive change in quickstart and note about serializer. will wait for SDK patch to land before merging.

Leo Chen: unit CI passed. rerunning e2e against PR artifact now.

pkg-ci: CI job pkg-ci/ci-e2e-notebook-demo #483 queued against PR artifact.

Maya Patel: thanks team. can we decide owners for backport/backward-compat note? i'd like Samir to own the release, Ana to own docs merge, Leo to own SDK patch and verify sampleapp runs on hosted canary. i'll add these to the release checklist.

Samir Gupta: ack — i'll cut 1.4.1 after merge and ping infra for canary rollout.

Leo Chen: e2e passed on PR artifact. test run: `OK 12 passed, 0 failed`

pkg-ci: CI job pkg-ci/ci-e2e-notebook-demo #483 succeeded.

Maya Patel: excellent. Ana — feel free to merge docs PR after Samir confirms the patch release (so quickstart links point to the right version).

Ana Rodriguez: will merge once release is cut, thanks.

Samir Gupta: 1.4.1 released and pushed to canary. infra notified for canary smoke. changelog cutoff preserved. :shipit:
